questions.question: Was the Day-5 sample fixed before replay?
questions.evidence: 1,000 mints selected by predeclared sha256 nave-2026-08-31-v1 ordering from denominator 37,540.

questions.question: Were all event hours complete?
questions.evidence: 24/24 PumpApi hours completed under bounded three-worker replay and materialized to Parquet.

questions.question: Does the survival label remain frozen and post-horizon?
questions.evidence: Unchanged strict (horizon,horizon+5m] activity window at one 10m row per token.

questions.question: Could missingness be hidden as inactivity?
questions.evidence: Provider gaps are zero; migration unknown and right censoring remain separate statuses.

questions.question: Is exact-mark observability activity-selected?
questions.evidence: 49 resolved tokens had median 229 early trades and 62 buyers versus 9 and 3 for 951 unresolved.

questions.question: Did C outperform A on Day 5?
questions.evidence: C minus A PR-AUC -0.0244 and Brier delta +0.00085 on unchanged transfer.

questions.question: Is the Day-5 difference statistically decisive?
questions.evidence: Bootstrap PR-AUC interval [-0.1282,+0.0511] and Brier interval [-0.00054,+0.00279] cross zero.

questions.question: Does this establish profitability or execution quality?
questions.evidence: Target is observable activity, not return, executable liquidity, or PnL.

questions.question: Are participant models ready?
questions.evidence: Point-in-time participant history is immature and raw flow is SELF-FLOW CONTAMINATED.

questions.question: Does four-day coverage establish temporal stability?
questions.evidence: C direction changes across frozen transfers and only four comparable days exist.

questions.question: Could late-launch censoring bias outcomes?
questions.evidence: Day-5 right censoring is 21/31/63 at 15m/30m/60m and remains explicit.

questions.question: Does the result justify operationalization?
questions.evidence: No live filter, scanner, alert, watch, trade, or capital behavior changed; EDGE_VALIDATED remains false.

remaining_risks: activity target may proxy trading persistence
raw participant flow is not exogenous
falsifiers: larger frozen evaluation reverses the observed A/C pattern
C repeatedly loses after preregistered continuation
economic conditional outcomes fail after observability conditioning
provider or migration audit reveals hidden missingness
next_review_gate: Reassess after at least five and preferably 5-7 frozen comparable event-level days with clustered uncertainty and outcome coverage review.
